title: 真实Envoy UDP会话：迟到回包、源端口换代、两会话上限与空闲释放
body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)，深拷贝后仅把UDP proxy的idle_timeout从0.05s改为批准2s，保留非透明、逐会话负载均衡、8192字节接收上限及cluster max_connections=2。真实UDP服务在150ms后回复：旧超时会先销毁映射，批准设置应收到完整含NUL回包。同一客户端tuple重发保持同上游会话；客户端改源端口产生独立会话，不能把回包送给旧端口。第三个并发会话须拒绝并增加overflow；两会话空闲过期实际释放后新会话可进入。上游主动倒序返回两个分片、遗漏第三片时原样转交，不擅自补包或宣告完整；过期旧会话回包不能串到新会话。客户端空闲后显式重试可创建新会话。所有端点、datagram及会话观测都实际运行，不靠配置文本推断。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
固定Envoy1.36.13，真实回环UDP代理与服务。改变客户端绑定源端口只模拟NAT重绑定后的可观测四元组变化，未改宿主NAT/conntrack。非透明上游看到代理源地址/端口，不能声称保留原客户端端口。丢包与乱序由受控上游故意制造，UDP本身不保证送达、顺序或业务恰好一次；应用须有身份、分片对账、重试与去重。8192是接收datagram上限，不是全进程内存/端口总上界。仅单后端，未验证在线后端地址调整、透明模式回程、跨代理迁移或公网MTU，不把本实验当原广域生产方案全部完成。不构建镜像。
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    result=copy.deepcopy(base)
    result["static_resources"]["listeners"][0]["listener_filters"][0]["typed_config"]["idle_timeout"]="2s"
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
交付客户端四元组、上游选择、会话idle timeout和是否逐包负载均衡，明确默认非透明路径中上游看到的是代理地址。验收客户端源端口变化、空闲后重发、上游多个回包和乱序丢包，核对响应不会发给错误会话。UDP发送成功不证明对方收到，业务重试与去重必须由应用协议负责。交付最大会话数、缓冲和端口资源预算，并测试后端变更时旧会话如何处理。透明源地址模式有平台能力与回程路由条件，不能仅开启字段便宣称保留了完整客户端地址；所有结论固定实际Envoy版本。

rubric: 解释过滤链、资源与协议的作用范围

明确版本、资源与失败策略

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,json,pathlib,socket,sys,threading,time,urllib.parse
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("checks").resolve()))
from envoy_native import Envoy,bootstrap,student
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
class UDPBackend:
 def __enter__(self):
  self.socket=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_DGRAM);self.socket.bind(("127.0.0.1",0));self.socket.settimeout(.05)
  self.port=self.socket.getsockname()[1];self.running=True;self.rows=[];self.lock=threading.Lock();self.timers=[]
  def receive():
   while self.running:
    try:raw,peer=self.socket.recvfrom(65535)
    except socket.timeout:continue
    except OSError:break
    with self.lock:self.rows.append((raw,peer))
    def later(delay,body,peer=peer):
     def send():
      try:self.socket.sendto(body,peer)
      except OSError:pass
     timer=threading.Timer(delay,send);self.timers.append(timer);timer.start()
    if raw.startswith(b"late:"):later(.15,b"echo:"+raw)
    elif raw.startswith(b"multi:"):
     later(.01,b"part2:"+raw);later(.04,b"part1:"+raw)
     # Intentional application-side omission; UDP delivery is not being guaranteed.
    else:self.socket.sendto(b"echo:"+raw,peer)
  self.thread=threading.Thread(target=receive);self.thread.start();return self
 def __exit__(self,*args):
  self.running=False;self.thread.join(1)
  for timer in self.timers:timer.join(1)
  self.socket.close()
 def peer(self,payload):
  with self.lock:return next(peer for raw,peer in reversed(self.rows) if raw==payload)
def client():
 endpoint=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_DGRAM);endpoint.bind(("127.0.0.1",0));endpoint.settimeout(.5);return endpoint
def absent(endpoint):
 try:raw=endpoint.recv(65535)
 except socket.timeout:return
 raise AssertionError("unexpected or cross-session datagram "+repr(raw))
def reply(endpoint):
 try:return endpoint.recv(8192)
 except socket.timeout as exc:raise AssertionError("expected real UDP reply absent within budget") from exc
def wait_stats(server,predicate,description):
 deadline=time.monotonic()+4
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  stats=server.stats()
  if predicate(stats):return stats
  time.sleep(.03)
 raise AssertionError(description+repr(server.stats()))
with UDPBackend() as backend:
 base=bootstrap(backend.port)
 listener={"name":"udp","address":{"socket_address":{"protocol":"UDP","address":"127.0.0.1","port_value":0}},
  "udp_listener_config":{"downstream_socket_config":{"max_rx_datagram_size":8192}},
  "listener_filters":[{"name":"envoy.filters.udp_listener.udp_proxy","typed_config":{
   "@type":"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.udp.udp_proxy.v3.UdpProxyConfig","stat_prefix":"session",
   "idle_timeout":"0.05s","use_per_packet_load_balancing":False,"upstream_socket_config":{"max_rx_datagram_size":8192},
   "matcher":{"on_no_match":{"action":{"name":"route","typed_config":{"@type":"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.udp.udp_proxy.v3.Route","cluster":"service"}}}}}}]}
 base["static_resources"]["listeners"]=[listener]
 cluster=base["static_resources"]["clusters"][0];cluster["circuit_breakers"]={"thresholds":[{"priority":"DEFAULT","max_connections":2}]}
 cluster["load_assignment"]["endpoints"][0]["lb_endpoints"][0]["endpoint"]["address"]["socket_address"]["protocol"]="UDP"
 with Envoy(base) as old,client() as endpoint:
  target=("127.0.0.1",urllib.parse.urlparse(old.base).port);endpoint.sendto(b"late:baseline",target);absent(endpoint)
  assert backend.peer(b"late:baseline")
  assert old.stats().get("udp.session.idle_timeout",0)>=1
 print("NATIVE_UDP_SHORT_IDLE_SESSION_EXPIRES_BEFORE_REAL_DELAYED_UPSTREAM_REPLY",flush=True)
 before=copy.deepcopy(base);fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert base==before
 with Envoy(fixed) as server,client() as a,client() as b,client() as c:
  target=("127.0.0.1",urllib.parse.urlparse(server.base).port)
  a.sendto(b"late:A\x00approved",target);assert reply(a)==b"echo:late:A\x00approved"
  peer_a=backend.peer(b"late:A\x00approved")
  a.sendto(b"same-session",target);assert a.recv(8192)==b"echo:same-session" and backend.peer(b"same-session")==peer_a
  # Source-port change models the observable tuple change; no host NAT rules are modified.
  assert a.getsockname()[1]!=b.getsockname()[1]
  b.sendto(b"same-application-new-tuple",target);assert b.recv(8192)==b"echo:same-application-new-tuple"
  peer_b=backend.peer(b"same-application-new-tuple");assert peer_b!=peer_a
  c.sendto(b"third-session",target);absent(c)
  with backend.lock:assert not any(raw==b"third-session" for raw,peer in backend.rows)
  stats=server.stats()
  assert stats["udp.session.downstream_sess_active"]==2 and stats["cluster.service.upstream_cx_overflow"]>=1
  b.sendto(b"multi:B",target)
  assert [b.recv(8192),b.recv(8192)]==[b"part2:multi:B",b"part1:multi:B"]
  a.settimeout(.1);absent(a);a.settimeout(.5)
  # No packet is synthesized to fill the missing third application response.
  b.settimeout(.1);absent(b);b.settimeout(.5)
  expired=wait_stats(server,lambda s:s.get("udp.session.downstream_sess_active")==0,"idle sessions were not released")
  assert expired["udp.session.idle_timeout"]>=2
  c.sendto(b"after-expiry",target);assert c.recv(8192)==b"echo:after-expiry"
  peer_c=backend.peer(b"after-expiry");assert peer_c not in (peer_a,peer_b)
  backend.socket.sendto(b"obsolete-session-reply",peer_a)
  c.settimeout(.1);a.settimeout(.1);b.settimeout(.1)
  absent(a);absent(b);absent(c)
  a.sendto(b"after-idle-retry",target);assert a.recv(8192)==b"echo:after-idle-retry"
  expected=copy.deepcopy(base);expected["static_resources"]["listeners"][0]["listener_filters"][0]["typed_config"]["idle_timeout"]="2s"
  assert fixed==expected,"only approved idle timeout may change; session/buffer bounds stay finite"
  print("NATIVE_UDP_NEW_SOURCE_PORT_NEW_SESSION_NO_CROSS_REPLY_TWO_SESSION_LIMIT_IDLE_RELEASE_AND_RETRY "+json.dumps(dict(
   client_ports=[a.getsockname()[1],b.getsockname()[1],c.getsockname()[1]],upstream_peers=[peer_a,peer_b,peer_c],
   overflow=stats["cluster.service.upstream_cx_overflow"],expired_sessions=expired["udp.session.idle_timeout"],
   nontransparent_proxy=True,per_packet_balancing=False)),flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
